issues.display_title: Issue #38: Integrate Countly analytics for the core user funnel
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Integrate Countly Web SDK into Street Builder to measure the core user funnel without changing the existing application logging flow.

Configuration

  • Countly server: https://data.gothru.org
  • SDK: countly-sdk-web@26.1.3
  • User identity: gothru_uid
  • App key is configured directly in the Countly analytics adapter; it must never be included in logs, events, or this issue.

Events

  • Login success and logout
  • Project created and opened
  • Video processing started, completed, and failed
  • Upload/re-upload started, completed, and failed

Privacy and reliability

  • Allow only approved event names and segmentation fields.
  • Do not send project names, file paths, tokens, raw errors, or other sensitive values.
  • Countly SDK failures must not interrupt application workflows.
  • Preserve the existing sendLog() and upload logging behavior.
  • Countly default session metadata is allowed: user agent, screen resolution/density, locale, OS/browser versions, and device type/model.

Acceptance criteria

  • Countly initializes against the configured server and app key.
  • Placeholder configuration sends no Countly requests.
  • Authenticated sessions use gothru_uid; logout resets identity.
  • Core funnel events are emitted once per relevant attempt.
  • Durations use monotonic timing and event data is sanitized.
  • Automated tests cover initialization, identity, privacy allowlists, project lifecycle, video processing, and upload lifecycle.
  • Development build succeeds.

issues.display_title: Issue #40: Migrate panorama upload to up2 API with coordinates
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by developer

Summary

Update panorama uploads to use the up2 endpoint and include Street Builder positioning data explicitly.

Problem

Panoramas uploaded without explicit coordinates can be positioned differently from their points in Street Builder. EXIF longitude references were also incorrect for western coordinates, which could change the interpreted location.

Required changes

  • Upload panoramas to https://up2.gothru.org/upload using multipart form data.
  • Send token, heading, latlng as signed JSON { lat, lng }, and file.
  • Keep the API latitude/longitude identical to the Street Builder point.
  • Write EXIF GPS values as absolute numbers with correct N/S and E/W references.
  • Preserve signed values in originlatitude, originlongtitude, and GPSAreaInformation.
  • Handle up2 responses and errors without temporary console logging.
  • Add regression coverage for upload fields and EXIF coordinate formatting.

Acceptance criteria

  • Uploaded panoramas retain their Street Builder coordinates.
  • Negative longitude uses the W EXIF reference; negative latitude uses S.
  • The upload succeeds only when the up2 response contains mid.
  • Upload and EXIF regression tests pass.

Implementation

Implemented in commits ba8e3cb and 0b8f1c9.
